evidence_items.source_title: Documentation for sports odds API V4
evidence_items.claim_summary: Soccer is documented with per-league sport keys (e.g. soccer_epl and other soccer leagues).
evidence_items.notes: Football/soccer is a first-class sport group in the API.

evidence_items.source_title: EPL Odds API | The Odds API
evidence_items.claim_summary: EPL odds are covered from multiple bookmakers by region (US/UK/EU/AU); historical EPL odds available from mid-2020 for featured markets.
evidence_items.excerpt: Historical EPL odds are available from mid-2020 for featured markets (moneyline, totals).

evidence_items.source_title: Documentation for sports odds API V4
evidence_items.claim_summary: Odds are returned per individual bookmaker; each event carries a bookmakers array with per-bookmaker prices.
evidence_items.notes: Distinct operator-attributed prices, not a single aggregated price.

evidence_items.source_title: Documentation for sports odds API V4
evidence_items.claim_summary: Each bookmaker has a stable 'key' (e.g. draftkings) plus a display 'title'.
evidence_items.notes: Raw/source operator identity only; not a LadybugBets canonical operator id.

evidence_items.source_title: Documentation for sports odds API V4
evidence_items.claim_summary: Events carry an 'id', plus sport_key, commence_time, home_team, away_team.
evidence_items.notes: Raw/source event identity; participant components (home_team/away_team) present.

evidence_items.source_title: Documentation for sports odds API V4
evidence_items.claim_summary: Markets use stable keys such as h2h (head-to-head / match winner), spreads, totals.

evidence_items.source_title: Documentation for sports odds API V4
evidence_items.claim_summary: Each market's outcomes carry a name and a price (and point for spreads/totals).

evidence_items.source_title: Documentation for sports odds API V4
evidence_items.claim_summary: last_update documents the last time odds updated from the bookmaker; historical snapshot 'timestamp' is the closest snapshot at or earlier than the requested time, i.e. the state time of the snapshot.
evidence_items.excerpt: last_update: Last time odds saw update from bookmaker.
evidence_items.notes: A bookmaker-originated quote-update time and an explicit snapshot state time; not merely an API response-generated time.

evidence_items.source_title: Documentation for sports odds API V4
evidence_items.claim_summary: Historical odds available from 2020-06-06 with 10-minute snapshots (5-minute from Sept 2022); historical endpoints are paid-plan only.
evidence_items.excerpt: Historical odds data is available from June 6th 2020.
evidence_items.notes: Technical availability of historical data; retention rights are a separate question.

evidence_items.source_title: Sports Odds API | The Odds API
evidence_items.claim_summary: Usage governed by monthly request credits per plan and documented 429 rate limiting with usage headers.
evidence_items.notes: Public self-serve plans with published monthly credit quotas and a free tier.

evidence_items.source_title: The Odds API Terms and Conditions
evidence_items.claim_summary: Commercial use is permitted, including displaying the data in a UI/website/app for commercial use, provided the data is not the primary product sold.
evidence_items.excerpt: Displaying our data in a UI, website, or mobile app, including for commercial use.

evidence_items.source_title: The Odds API Terms and Conditions
evidence_items.claim_summary: Storing the data and retaining it indefinitely is explicitly permitted.
evidence_items.excerpt: Storing our data and retaining it indefinitely.

evidence_items.source_title: The Odds API Terms and Conditions
evidence_items.claim_summary: Retaining the data indefinitely is explicitly permitted, which supports building a historical dataset from pulled observations.
evidence_items.excerpt: Storing our data and retaining it indefinitely.

evidence_items.source_title: The Odds API Terms and Conditions
evidence_items.claim_summary: Calculating and displaying values derived from the data is permitted (e.g. analytical dashboards).
evidence_items.excerpt: Calculating and displaying values you derive from our data.

evidence_items.source_title: The Odds API Terms and Conditions
evidence_items.claim_summary: Public display of the data in a UI/website/app, including for commercial use, is explicitly permitted.
evidence_items.excerpt: Displaying our data in a UI, website, or mobile app, including for commercial use.

evidence_items.source_title: The Odds API Terms and Conditions
evidence_items.claim_summary: Reselling, repackaging, or redistributing the raw data as a standalone data product (including via APIs or feeds) is prohibited.
